title: Minnesota lawyer suspended over fake AI case citations

reading.body:
The title indicates a lawyer in Minnesota was suspended in connection with submitting fake case citations generated by an AI system. This belongs to a well-documented failure mode in which a generative AI model asserts fabricated legal citations as fact, and a user submits those citations in a legal proceeding without independently verifying them. The failure occurs at the point of human use, after the model's output leaves the system, because no checking step caught the fabrications before they reached a court.

The article body was not retrievable, so the specific citations involved, the disciplinary body's findings, the length of the suspension, and any other details of the case are not established from the available material.
